Before ticking, read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md): it explains every box below.

- [ ] One folder directly under `skills/`; folder name, header `name` and README H1 match
- [ ] Header contains exactly `name` and `description`; description is a quoted single line
- [ ] SKILL.md has all nine sections in order, including the human approval checkpoint
- [ ] Complements a built-in and duplicates none; the README says which
- [ ] Host-neutral wording with the Markdown fallback
- [ ] No scripts, images, PDFs or zips in the skill folder
- [ ] No invented facts, URLs or statistics; missing information is marked UNKNOWN or ASSUMPTION
- [ ] British spelling; no em or en dashes; no hype words; no exclamation marks
- [ ] README Status line is truthful (tenant-tested with date, or format-validated only)
- [ ] Added to `scripts/catalog.json`, the README catalog table and `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate` passes
